content.title: Meaning of the name Adame
content.text: Introduction Family Hinduism Buddhism Jainism Christianity See also Background, origin and meaning of Adame: The name Adame is primarily a male name with Hebrew origins, derived from the name Adam. Its meaning is "son of the red earth" or simply "man." In the Bible, Adam is the name of the first man created by God, making the name deeply rooted in religious and cultural significance. The name reflects humanity's connection to the earth and the material world. Adame is less common than its root name, Adam, but shares the same foundational meaning and historical context. Associated names include Adam, Adams, and Addy. Several notable individuals share a variation of this name. Adam Sandler (born 1966) is a famous American actor, comedian, and filmmaker, known for his comedic roles in movies and his work on Saturday Night Live. Adam Driver (born 1983) is an American actor known for his roles in the "Star Wars" sequel trilogy and critically acclaimed films, demonstrating his versatility and talent in the acting world. Adam Smith (1723-1790) was a Scottish economist and philosopher, widely regarded as the father of modern economics, whose book "The Wealth of Nations" has had a lasting impact on economic thought and policy.
